flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-7, Region 4 Kootenay. Near the MU line: check the MU map.
Route crosses private land (ParcelMap BC, updated 2026-10-01): get permission first or go around.
Private land 100 m W: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).
Inside CRESTON VALLEY WILDLIFE MANAGEMENT AREA Wildlife Management Area: rules differ by area. Call the regional office before you hunt (synopsis page 9, 99%).

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-7: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).
Wolf: no closed season in MU 4-7 below 1,100 m (synopsis page 39 footnote, 90%: the Trench line is not mapped and "below 1,100 m" is my reading for both groups). VERIFY with the regional office.

plan: Drive: from Boswell, about 40 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 3A, Lower Wynndel Rd, Hwy 3, Topaz Creek FSR.
Park: 49.18609, -116.66359, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 810 m NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 16 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-7, Region 4. CWD zone: deer, elk and moose heads go to a CWD freezer; brain and spine stay in the zone. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.8 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
